# Save per-language report mirroring ExportDesignModel behavior.
        REPORTS_MODEL_KPI_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        from dataclasses import asdict

        raw = asdict(insights)
        data: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for k, v in raw.items():
            if v is None:
                continue
            if isinstance(v, tuple):
                v = list(v)
            data[k] = v
        (REPORTS_MODEL_KPI_DIR / "py.json").write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")

        # Load canonical asset and require exact numeric match for shared fields.
        canonical_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ASSETS_DIR, "model-kpi-nakagin.json")
        with open(canonical_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            canonical = json.load(f)
        for key, expected in canonical.items():
            assert key in data, f"missing key {key} in insights"
            assert data[key] == expected, f"mismatch for {key}: {data[key]} != {expected}"
